doc.title: Nancy Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Joe Williams and the Basie band
summary: She calls Basie the best band she worked with, remembers Joe Williams with it and the Hollywood Bowl tribute.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: How is your — I know that you and Joe Williams go back quite a ways.

Joe is new with John Levy. He’s only been with him maybe fifteen or twenty years. One of the, if not the best band that I have ever worked with was the Basie band. Count Basie’s band swings like no other band ever. There just was never a band like that. Joe Williams was, at that time when Joe Williams was with the Basie band, I mean it didn’t get any better than Joe Williams and the Basie band. I love the ballads that Joe sings today but I really love the energy that was there with the Basie band. Joe Williams was one of the nicer people in the world. We, and I say John Levy, were very close. He’s still working, and working extremely well. I was so pleased to do the tribute to Joe Williams at the Hollywood Bowl this year. Joe just sings so, I mean he’s just magnificent. He’s a treasure. Truly a treasure.
We’ve talked to a good number of Basie alumnus and from other groups too.
And no one can quite put it into words, but there certainly is the feeling that you just expressed that that band just chugged along like no other.
